description.text: The second Gym set, released on 16 October 2000 with 132 cards and a theme deck for each of Sabrina, Koga, Blaine and Giovanni. Blaine's Arcanine was the first Pokémon to do more than 100 damage in one attack and Rocket's Mewtwo the first card with three attacks. Like Gym Heroes, most of its art is by Ken Sugimori, and several pictures were changed for the English release.
